archive_request_audit.do_not_do: Do not ask Hannah to interpret whether any feature is artificial, crater-like or anomalous.

archive_request_audit.current_strength: BODC confirmed MBANSWCB existed in em122.ACO and was not transferred to the final processed series; originator-file route is real.
archive_request_audit.scope_risk: em122.ACO may establish multibeam-depth provenance but may still be insufficient to reconstruct the exact H10N1 swath footprint or ping/beam intersection.
archive_request_audit.request_rule: Get em122.ACO first if that is the available originator artifact, but do not stop there merely because the filename was requested. If it lacks swath geometry, request the minimum raw/processed measurement chain that closes the boolean: raw Kongsberg EM122 datagrams or equivalent, processed XYZ/grid with line/ping identity, or explicit ping/beam footprint/bounding geometry.
archive_request_audit.do_not_do: Do not infer swath intersection from centerline navigation alone.

where_we_almost_left_the_road: Treating free-azimuth Kamil geometry as if fixed architecture supported EDEM.
Treating the legacy 3.854924E longitude as intrinsically fixed by LOVE/EDEM.
Allowing 520-class or 119-Hz frequency proximity to behave like identity keys.
Potentially counting a full-360 MAR closest longitude as a discovered location.
Potentially counting the TOBI latitude crossing as independent spatial confirmation when the latitude selected it.
Allowing the rich HA10 data lane to replace rather than calibrate the original Cousteau question.
Risking a file-name-driven JR15001 request instead of a measurement-question-driven exact swath gate.
why_the_project_is_still_on_course: Each major attractive false lead was eventually subjected to a stronger control and downgraded rather than hidden.
Coordinates/windows have repeatedly been frozen and no-retarget rules preserved.
Negative results remain in the record.
Current best next steps are primary-byte and provenance acquisition, not new semantic target invention.
The latest CD169 synthetic geometry run explicitly separates calibration from morphology and forbids using log-derived crossing as independent prediction.
Custodian replies are being used to improve provenance paths, not as target evidence.
